_meta.purpose: Smallest valid static.site artifact: a single index.html, no tweaks, app delivery mode. Golden 'happy path' input for the static_site finalizer + static_standalone export oracle.

semantic_metadata.note: data-disco-* metadata grammar present even in the minimal site so the host can anchor section identity and version. Element -> source mappings below.

tweak_metadata.note: static.site minimal carries NO tweaks. .disco/tweaks.json is intentionally absent; AppSpec.tweaks is not used for static.site. Empty by design.

evidence_host_must_observe: preview_start serves index.html on a route with HTTP 200
verify_web_app screenshot shows visible, styled content (non-blank body, computed background/text contrast present)
browser console is free of uncaught errors
required file index.html exists at project root

known_invalid_variants.name: missing_index
known_invalid_variants.mutation: required_files lists index.html but no index.html exists at project root
known_invalid_variants.expected_failure: ready_for_static_site_verification rejects: required file index.html absent; finalizer cannot route to a served page

known_invalid_variants.name: blank_body
known_invalid_variants.mutation: index.html present but body renders no visible content (empty/all display:none)
known_invalid_variants.expected_failure: static_site finalizer (standard level) rejects: screenshot oracle observes blank/unstyled page, fails visible-styled-content evidence

known_invalid_variants.name: console_error
known_invalid_variants.mutation: index.html references a missing script that throws an uncaught ReferenceError on load
known_invalid_variants.expected_failure: static_site finalizer rejects: console-clean evidence fails (uncaught error observed during verify_web_app)
